name: מעבר מהצגה קוטבית להצגה קרטזית (באנגלית)

functions.name: igcd2
functions.body: if b=0 then abs(a) else igcd2(b,mod(a,b))

functions.name: texp
functions.body: if constantp(x) and freeof(%i,x) and is(x<0) then sconcat("\\left(",tex1(x),"\\right)") else tex1(x)

functions.name: texnsum
functions.body: block([L:first(args(e))], sconcat(tex1(first(L)), apply(sconcat, map(lambda([t], if constantp(t) and is(t<0) then sconcat("-",tex1(-t)) else sconcat("+",tex1(t))), rest(L)))))

functions.name: rsq
functions.body: block([s,t,nn,dd,aa:1,mm:1,g,u], if ratnump(x) then return(tex1(x)), s: if is(x<0) then "-" else "", t: ratsimp(x^2), nn: num(t), dd: denom(t), for f in ifactors(nn*dd) do (aa: aa*f[1]^floor(f[2]/2), mm: mm*f[1]^mod(f[2],2)), g: igcd2(aa,dd), aa: aa/g, dd: dd/g, u: sconcat(if aa=1 then "" else string(aa), "\\sqrt{", string(mm), "}"), if dd=1 then sconcat(s,u) else sconcat(s,"\\frac{",u,"}{",string(dd),"}"))

functions.name: cxq
functions.body: block([r1:"", i1:""], if p#0 then r1: rsq(p), if q#0 then (i1: if is(abs(q)=1) then "\\mathrm{i}" else sconcat(rsq(abs(q)), "\\mathrm{i}"), i1: if is(q<0) then sconcat("-",i1) else if p#0 then sconcat("+",i1) else i1), if p=0 and q=0 then "0" else sconcat(r1,i1))

questiontext:
Consider the complex number \(z\) with modulus \(|z| = {{CT:0}}\) and argument \(\arg(z) = {{CT:1}} \).

Convert this number into the form \(p + qi\) where \(p\) and \(q\) are real.

\( z = \) [[input:ans1]]
[[validation:ans1]]

How to enter: the imaginary unit \(i\) is typed as the letter i (or %i), and multiplication with a star. For example 3-2*i.
generalfeedback:
Outline: A complex number with modulus \(r\) and argument \(\theta\) is \(z=r(\cos\theta+i\sin\theta)\), so \(p=r\cos\theta\) and \(q=r\sin\theta\).
Step 1 — The real part
The values of cosine and sine at \(\theta={{CT:1}}\) are known exactly (their signs follow the quadrant of \(\theta\)):

\[ \cos\left({{CT:1}}\right)={{CT:2}},\qquad \sin\left({{CT:1}}\right)={{CT:3}} \]

Hence

\[ p=r\cos\theta={{CT:0}}\cdot\cos\left({{CT:1}}\right)={{CT:4}}={{CT:5}}[[if test="{{CT:12}}"]]={{CT:6}}[[/if]] \]

Step 2 — The imaginary part

\[ q=r\sin\theta={{CT:0}}\cdot\sin\left({{CT:1}}\right)={{CT:7}}={{CT:8}}[[if test="{{CT:13}}"]]={{CT:9}}[[/if]] \]

Step 3 — The answer

\[ z=p+qi={{CT:10}}[[if test="{{CT:14}}"]]={{CT:11}}[[/if]] \]

on_true.feedback: The real part of your answer is correct.

on_false.feedback: The real part of your answer is incorrect

on_true.feedback: The imaginary part of your answer is correct.

on_false.feedback: The imaginary part of your answer is incorrect.

on_true.feedback: Your answer is equivalent to the correct answer, but not in the required format \(p + q i\).
